caption: The drawing depicts a stylized interior wall featuring a central fireplace. The fireplace is rectangular with a blue border and a brick-patterned interior in shades of red and orange; there is a simple black andirons or grate at the bottom center of the firebox. The wall above and around the fireplace is covered with an evenly spaced pattern of botanical motifs in green and black ink on a white background. Directly above the fireplace at the center is a larger, loosely rendered green willow tree illustration. The surrounding wall space features repeated stylized palm or fern-like plants, small black dots, and segmented green semi-circles, all arranged in a regular grid-like fashion. A horizontal band of twisted green and white rope or vine runs across the wall just above the fireplace opening and again along the lower borders of the side panels. At the very top of the wall is a decorative frieze featuring an alternating pattern of arched green motifs and black starburst or floral designs, enclosed in a narrow rectangular border. The overall color palette consists of light green, dark green, black, blue, red, and white, with all shapes and forms rendered in a flat, two-dimensional manner.
title: Wall Stencil (copy)
